items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I know you've heard of Pony Moe. Yes. Well, Pony Moe lived over there, and I moved over there after he moved, after he died.

ctx.x: They might have moved. Right around in there. Mm-hmm. Because, no, it wasn't. Because when they moved the monogram, 35th Street, yes, it was, because I had bought my house then at 33rd. And I bought that in 19 and 19, that's when I moved that, in 1919. 1919. Yes, that's when I moved to 35th Street. That was one of the first colored families that moved over there, because Pony Moe. I know you've heard of Pony Moe. Yes. Well, Pony Moe lived over there, and I moved over there after he moved, after he died.
